It describes S1000D as an international standard for technical publication procurement and production, originally developed by European aerospace and defense industries in the early 1980s and now jointly maintained by international organizations. The chapter details the specification's evolution from military and civil aviation documentation practices, key advantages of standardization, and subsequent international agreements establishing joint governance and harmonization efforts across North American and European organizations.

This document is an introductory chapter explaining the scope and fundamental purpose of the S1000D specification.
